types.name: Scatter diagram and properties of r
types.description: Asks about the range or meaning of r, types of correlation, scatter diagrams, r², probable error, or how r changes when the variables are shifted or rescaled.

types.name: Computing Karl Pearson's r
types.description: Gives paired data, or covariance and SDs, or sums like Σxy and Σx², and asks for the correlation coefficient.

types.name: Spearman's rank correlation
types.description: Gives ranks given by two judges, or Σd² and n, and asks for the rank correlation coefficient, sometimes with tied ranks.

types.name: Regression coefficients
types.description: Gives r with SDs, or the two regression coefficients, and asks for byx, bxy or r.

types.name: Regression lines, means and estimates
types.description: Gives two regression equations (or one equation and a value) and asks for the means, r, which line is which, or an estimate of y from x.

types.name: Association of attributes
types.description: Gives a 2 × 2 table of attribute frequencies and asks whether they are independent or associated, or for Yule's Q or the coefficient of colligation.

types.name: Partial and multiple correlation
types.description: Gives r₁₂, r₁₃ and r₂₃ and asks for a partial correlation such as r₁₂.₃ or a multiple correlation such as R₁.₂₃, or their properties.
